title: Ask URA Commissioner General 9 - Uganda Revenue Authority
text:
# Ask URA Commissioner General 9
Regulation of Tax Agents What measures has URA put in place to regulate and monitor tax agents to ensure they act professionally and ethically when representing traders?
Dear Reader,
The Tax Procedures Code Act (TPCA) provides for the establishment of the Tax Agents Registration Committee (TARC) which is mandated to register, renew and cancel tax agents’ registration.
TARC, has developed a code of conduct for regulating the operations of tax agents including the assessment of their professional and ethical behavior. Where they are found wanting, the Committee may revoke their registration as a tax agent.
Addressing Unprofessional Conduct by Agents In cases where tax agents act negligently or dishonestly and cause financial loss to traders, what mechanisms exist for traders to report them and seek redress?
Dear Reader,
Tax agents are registered by the Tax Agent Registration Committee (TARC) and appointed by a taxpayer.
URA has provided a platform; touchpoint.ura.go.ug accessible via the URA web portal where a taxpayer can lodge a complaint regarding a tax agent. A taxpayer must clearly state the circumstances that have led to the alleged financial loss or negligence/ dishonesty.
Upon receipt, the Committee will review the complaint and avail an opportunity to the tax agent and taxpayer to present their respective facts. A tax agent found to be negligent or dishonest by the Committee may have their registration cancelled.
In addition, the taxpayer may also seek legal redress in courts of law where financial loss has been caused or the agent has acted negligently.
Can a company register an additional or substituted Tax Agent?
Dear Reader,
A partnership or company registered as a tax agent may apply to the Tax Agent Registration Committee (TARC) to register a partner of the partnership or an employee of the company as an additional or substituted tax agent.
Training and Continuous Professional Development of Agents Where do URA-recognized agents receive their training, and does URA provide ongoing refresher training to maintain service quality?
Dear Reader,
URA has planned trainings for tax agents to equip them with knowledge and pre-requisite skills to enable them execute their roles effectively. Trainings are conducted physically at designated locations and time. For online trainings, a link is shared with tax agents via their registered emails and our social media platforms.
Criteria for Accrediting Tax Agents What qualifications, training, and standards does URA require before granting agents permission to operate on its behalf?
Dear Reader,
For a person to be registered as a tax agent, they must meet the following requirements:
A degree or post graduate award from an approved tertiary institution in a discipline relevant for a provision of tax agents services; or
Completed a course in taxation that is recognized by Tax Agent Registration Committee (TARC); or
Engaged in the equivalent of 24 months of full-time tax practice within a period of 5 years preceding the 1 st day of July 2016.
Must be fit and proper to prepare tax returns and transact business with the Commissioner General on behalf of the taxpayer.
Must be of high integrity and good character.
What happens if an agent ceases to carry on business as a tax agent?
Dear Reader,
Where a tax agent ceases to carry on business as a tax agent, they shall notify the Tax Agent Registration Committee (TARC) in writing within 7 days after ceasing the business.
Where the Committee is satisfied that the tax agent has ceased to carry out business as a tax agent, it may cancel the registration and notify the tax agent in writing of the decision to cancel the registration.
